title: Bug Ledger Admin — the same bug across apps and analyses
summary: There was no admin. Now /admin reads every tier of the ledger at once — the curated catalogue, the hourly harvester, scanner findings, agent submissions, every check-log and every scan story — and clusters 1,607 recorded instances into 1,168 bug classes by detector id and fuzzy title, so the same bug popping up in different apps and different analyses is visible as one row: 64 classes recur in 2+ apps and 28 in 3+. Views: bug classes (app chips, source bars, sparklines, instance tables with links to the story or report), an app × bug heatmap, a by-analysis view showing which recurring classes each scan hit, an over-time chart and by-source tiles, plus JSON/CSV export. It reads all reports and keeps re-reading every minute; a since-your-last-visit panel flags new reports, new classes and classes that spread to more apps until you mark them seen. Token-gated, read-only.

tasks.text: Wave 0 — Check for an existing admin + map every data source
tasks.desc: None existed. Six sources mapped; exact titles never repeat across apps in the curated catalogue, so clustering had to be class-level
GET /api/admin/recurrence, token-gated, returns every instance with source, app, title, category, severity, file, date, detector and a link back to its analysis
Union-find clustering client-side (31 ms for 1,607 instances) with prototype-free maps; five views, search, filters, sort, export; watch mode + since-last-visit diff
Rendered on real data via a local harness fed by the API (the admin key was never typed into a form); found and fixed a prototype-key crash and a [hidden] pill leak on the way

features: /admin recurrence board with app × bug heatmap, by-analysis, over-time and by-source views
GET /api/admin/recurrence (token-gated) across catalogue, harvested, scanner, submitted, check-logs, stories
Reads every report and re-reads every minute; since-your-last-visit panel with NEW / +n badges
JSON and CSV export of bug classes
harvested.json + scan-findings.json now published for tooling
bugfixes: Plain-object map keyed by bug-title words collided with Object.prototype ('constructor') and crashed the page — prototype-free maps (ledgered as a bug class)
'watching for new reports' pill showed on the login gate — [hidden] beaten by a display rule (the class ledgered yesterday, caught by our own eyes this time)
issues: Curated catalogue entries carry no date, so they sit outside the over-time chart (they still count in classes and the heatmap)

Fuzzy title clustering is a heuristic (Jaccard ≥ 0.5 on stemmed tokens, or 80% containment); a few near-duplicates may still split or merge — the instance table under each class shows exactly what was grouped
findings: Missing CSP / security headers is the most widespread class: 6 apps, 13 instances, 12 analyses
No tests anywhere and no Open Graph card each recur in 6 apps; empty catch blocks in 5 apps (50 instances); stored/DOM XSS sinks in 4 apps (79 instances)
insights: A bug in 3+ apps is a rule, a detector or a shared module waiting to be written — the heatmap is the backlog for the modules site
Never type an admin token into a page to verify it; feed the page real API data through a local harness instead
